_about: Model handoff for every NEW item the content/loot tables reference. The Forge agent submits Asset Forge jobs from this list; this file never triggers jobs itself. route: asset-forge = rigid or loose gear, weapons, props, materials; blender-garment = body-tight clothing built in Blender on the MetaHuman body. priority 1 = drops in Greenlands/Silverbrook now (tables assigned to existing spawn groups); 2 = drops from a unique/boss table whose creature is not yet placed. Prompt templates: docs/art-templates/weapons.md, armor.md, props.md; prompts below are the MAIN CONCEPT plus the house-style framing (clean multi-view reference sheet, neutral warm-grey studio backdrop, soft flat lighting, grounded frontier craftsmanship, no text except view labels, no logos, metre scale cue).
house_style: Game-asset concept reference, Shattered Frontier Greenlands: grounded high-fantasy frontier craftsmanship, practical materials, restrained ornament, visible evidence of making and use. ONE clean reference sheet of a single asset: large three-quarter view plus side and front/end (or FRONT / RIGHT / BACK for worn pieces on a neutral 1.8 m A-pose figure), identical scale and baseline, neutral warm-grey studio backdrop, soft flat readable lighting, no perspective distortion, no dramatic shadows, no text other than view labels, no logos or insignia, a simple scale cue in metres. Realistic fantasy art direction with a simple readable silhouette a game prototype can reproduce.

items.visual: Rolled grey-brown wolf hide bound once with a hide cord; fur side out, raw flesh side visible at the roll end.
items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a rolled grey-brown wolf pelt tied with a single hide cord, fur outward, flesh side showing at the open end, as a loot drop and inventory prop. Follow the house style; prop template.

items.visual: Single curved ivory canine with a darker root, slight wear on the tip.
items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a single curved wolf canine tooth, ivory with a darker porous root and a lightly worn tip, as a loot drop and crafting material. Follow the house style; prop template.

items.visual: Pair of forearm bracers of grey wolf hide, fur turned inward, laced along the inner arm with hide thong; rough stitched edges.
items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a pair of forearm bracers cut from grey wolf hide with the fur turned inward, laced with hide thong along the inner forearm, rough overcast stitching at the edges. Show as individual armor pieces, not a dressed figure. Follow the house style; armor template.

items.visual: Knee-length cloak of two stitched wolf pelts, fur outward across the shoulders, plain wool-lined body, bone toggle at the throat.
items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a knee-length cloak made from two grey wolf pelts stitched down the spine, fur outward over the shoulders, undyed wool lining below, closed at the throat with a carved bone toggle. Show worn on a neutral 1.8 m A-pose figure, FRONT / RIGHT / BACK. Follow the house style; armor template.

items.visual: Single-edged iron dagger with a slight recurve; grip wrapped in dark leather with a wolf fang set into the pommel cap; plain iron cross guard.
items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a single-edged iron dagger with a gently recurved blade, short plain iron guard, dark leather-wrapped grip and a wolf fang set into a bronze pommel cap; include a plain leather sheath in the stowed view. Follow the house style; weapon template.

items.visual: Short shoulder mantle from one large pale-grey alpha pelt, head-skin draped over the left shoulder, held by a crossed leather strap with an iron ring.
items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a short shoulder mantle made from a single large pale-grey wolf pelt, the head-skin draped over the left shoulder, fastened across the chest by a crossed leather strap through an iron ring, hanging to mid-back. Show worn on a neutral 1.8 m A-pose figure, FRONT / RIGHT / BACK. Follow the house style; armor template.

items.visual: Heavy one-handed club of knotted oak, head wrapped with two iron bands and square nail heads, grip worn smooth with a wrist cord.
items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a heavy one-handed club of knotted oak, its thick head bound with two rusted iron bands studded with square nail heads, the grip worn smooth with a hide wrist cord through a drilled hole. Follow the house style; weapon template.

items.visual: Quilted linen jack in faded brown, vertical stitched channels, laced front, elbow-length sleeves, scuffed and patched at one elbow.
items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a hip-length quilted linen jack in faded brown with vertical stitched channels, front closed by crossed leather lacing, elbow-length sleeves, one elbow patched with darker cloth. Body-tight over the player tunic. Show worn on a neutral 1.8 m A-pose figure, FRONT / RIGHT / BACK. Follow the house style; armor template.

items.visual: Broad falchion-style one-handed blade with a clipped point, blackened iron S-guard, grip of cord over wood, pommel a plain iron disc; nicked edge.
items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a broad falchion-style one-handed blade with a clipped point and a nicked, oft-sharpened edge, blackened iron S-shaped guard, cord-wrapped wooden grip and a plain iron disc pommel; include a crude leather scabbard in the stowed view. Follow the house style; weapon template.

items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a close-fitting coif of hardened brown leather covering the crown, ears and nape, built from four stitched panels with a chin strap and small iron buckle. Show worn on a neutral 1.8 m A-pose figure head, FRONT / RIGHT / BACK. Follow the house style; armor template.

items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a pair of thin brown leather archer's gloves, the right hand with reinforced double-layer draw fingers, the left with a short laced bracer flap over the forearm, both with laced wrists. Show as individual armor pieces, not a dressed figure. Follow the house style; armor template.

items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a sleeveless thick dark-leather jerkin with rows of dome-headed iron studs across chest and shoulders, closed with side lacing, a faded red cloth sash sewn around the waist. Body-tight over the player tunic. Show worn on a neutral 1.8 m A-pose figure, FRONT / RIGHT / BACK. Follow the house style; armor template.

items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: brown leather trousers reinforced with hardened leather panels riveted over the thighs and shins, held by buckled straps behind the knees, scuffed and darkened at the shins. Body-tight over the player leggings. Show worn on a neutral 1.8 m A-pose figure, FRONT / RIGHT / BACK. Follow the house style; armor template.

items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a well-maintained one-handed longsword with a straight double-edged blade and shallow fuller, slightly down-curved iron cross guard, grip bound in faded red cord, iron wheel pommel with a worn brass inlay; include a leather scabbard with iron chape in the stowed view. items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a practical elm self bow with a worn leather grip, plain linen string and small horn nocks, made for a Greenlands bandit archer. Show the unstrung profile beside the strung bow. Follow the house style; weapon template.

items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a straight ash quarterstaff with a worn leather central grip and simple iron ferrules at both ends, sturdy enough for travel and basic spellwork. Follow the house style; weapon template.

items.concept_prompt: MAIN CONCEPT: a modest round wooden shield made from dark planks, with a plain iron boss and rim and repaired leather arm straps on the back. Show front, edge and back at matching scale. Follow the house style; armor template.
